culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Kei Nakanishi. She did it to avenge her boyfriend, Natsuyuki Ogawa, who died three years ago. When he suddenly fell ill, he was to be transported to the hospital by an ambulance, but it didn't reach on time due to a car that was parked in the middle of the road. Kei investigated to find the car's owner, which turned out to be Remi Kirisaki. Kei talked to her about it, but Remi, with a laugh, said "He was just never meant to live long in the first place."
